title: Back-to-Back AHB SINGLE Transfers
description: Two independent SINGLE transfers show how one transfer's data phase overlaps the next transfer's NONSEQ address phase.

annotations.message: Transfer 1 address phase: NONSEQ, HBURST=SINGLE, HADDR=0x1000, and HWRITE=0 identify an independent read.
Transfer 1 read data completes while Transfer 2 starts with a fresh NONSEQ write address. The overlap improves throughput, but the transfers remain independent.
Transfer 2 write data completes with HREADY=1 and HRESP=OKAY. HTRANS is already IDLE because no third address phase is active.
The bus is idle. Another SINGLE transfer would restart with NONSEQ, never SEQ.
